quotes.name: Dan DiGangi
quotes.quote: Josue is one of the best engineers I've managed in my career. His attention to detail is relentless in the best way. He catches what others miss and cares enough to fix it properly.

quotes.name: Josiah Mangiameli
quotes.quote: Josue is one of the most reliable and trustworthy engineers I've had the privilege of leading as a product partner. (…) He could run with a goal and execute autonomously, but he always knew exactly when to push for a sync to resolve a key decision.

quotes.name: Bryan Gelfius
quotes.quote: He asks the question that actually matters — the duplicated validation, the third-party API whose response nobody had verified — and he asks it kindly.

quotes.name: Chris Oaldon
quotes.quote: He consistently documented processes to make work easier and repeatable and to help distribute knowledge amongst the team. He carried his responsibility as the sole rails engineer with excellence.

quotes.name: Eli Wood
quotes.quote: Josue is a fantastic collaborator. He brought a calm focus and high standard of quality to every sprint. Any engineering team would be lucky to have Josue.

quotes.name: Chris Flack
quotes.quote: He's also great at keeping customer needs and big-picture business logic in sight as he develops a technical solution. He'll be an asset to any team!
